compatibility_decision: additive only on V1-frozen symbols (2026-09-16, repository owner). Batch 3a's amendment applies here too: a new key in the bytes of an existing V1 record is not additive, so every new field below is serialized only when it carries information and is opt-in for producers
what_was_already_seen: the audit agent's reproductions: an oracle comparison of {y: 1 m} attached to a result at y = 42 m, another model and T = 5000 K attains EXPERIMENTALLY_VALIDATED (latent: the trusted-oracle registry is empty); an assessment computed at T = 300 K attaches IN_DOMAIN to a result whose provenance records T = 5000 K; Uncertainty has no source category

oracle_conditions.rule: OracleObservation gains conditions (name -> Quantity, default empty). OracleEvidenceSet.compare gains a keyword conditions. When any observation declares conditions, the comparison is made only if every declared condition is supplied and agrees with it; otherwise the check is NOT_RUN, establishes no level, and says which condition was missing or differed
oracle_conditions.agreement: same dimension and |a - b| <= 1e-9 * max(|a|, |b|) in the observation's unit, or both zero
oracle_conditions.agreement_class: A (the same operating point stated twice)
oracle_conditions.why_not_run_not_fail: a comparison at other conditions is not evidence against the model; FAIL would make the verdict NOT_SUPPORTED on a comparison that was never made
oracle_conditions.serialization: conditions is written only when non-empty, so the content digest of every existing evidence set is unchanged

validity_binding.rule: ValidityAssessment gains evaluated (name -> Quantity, default empty), filled by ValidityDomain.assess(..., record_values=True) with every Quantity the domain's conditions read. ScientificResult refuses an assessment whose evaluated value differs from the provenance input of the same name (agreement as above)
validity_binding.opt_in: record_values defaults to False: filling it by default would change the bytes of every serialized result
validity_binding.serialization: evaluated is written only when non-empty

uncertainty_source.rule: Uncertainty gains source_kind: UNSPECIFIED (default), MEASUREMENT, PARAMETER, NUMERICAL, MODEL_FORM or COMBINED. A NUMERICAL-only record says, in its own field, that it is not the value's scientific uncertainty. Cross-domain transfer carries source_kind through unchanged
uncertainty_source.serialization: source_kind is written only when not UNSPECIFIED

stated_residuals_before_implementation: CORE-009: a ValidationCheck is still not bound to the result it qualifies (the deferred VAL-01 field); conditions only stop a comparison made at other conditions from counting
CORE-014: opt-in, so an assessment built without record_values binds nothing; no domain opts in within this batch
CORE-016: QuantityTransfer still carries no upstream credibility, and nothing combines uncertainty sources
